# Nouli

> Nouli is a decision graph: a CLI and Rust library that runs decision models over many turns and feeds earlier decisions into later ones. A decision model returns a probability for each answer to a question with a fixed set of answers. Nouli keeps every fact, question, and answer of a session in a ledger, so each turn sends only what is new.

Install with `curl -fsSL https://standing-desks.github.io/nouli/install.sh | sh` (Linux, or macOS without Homebrew) or `brew install standing-desks/tap/nouli` (macOS). Define a provider in `~/.nouli/config.toml`, then run `nouli auth login PROVIDER`, which reads the key without echo; let the person type it.

Rules for driving Nouli from an agent:

- `nouli new NAME [FACT...] -q Q` starts a session; `--from A --from B` blends sessions, so their history is in view.
- `nouli add SESSION [FACT...] -q Q` adds facts and asks one question; `nouli ask SESSION -q Q` asks without new facts; `nouli whatif SESSION [FACT...] -q Q` asks and saves nothing.
- Each command asks exactly one `-q` question, in one call. A question is one line: `id: prompt [a, b]` for a choice, `id: prompt <low, high>` for an ordered score, `id: prompt` for yes/no.
- Each question is asked once; to decide again, ask a new question. Earlier answers stay as they were.
- Add `--json` to any command for a version-1 report. `--input FILE` takes a complete request instead of facts and `-q`. `--request-id KEY` replays a completed turn instead of calling the model again.
- `nouli facts SESSION`, `nouli context SESSION`, and `nouli view SESSION` show the numbered facts, what reached the model, and the decision graph.

## Docs

- [Command line](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/standing-desks/nouli/main/docs/cli.md): every command, facts, questions, request files, interactive sessions, and recovery
- [Output formats](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/standing-desks/nouli/main/docs/output.md): text, JSON, JSONL, and TOON reports
- [Decision contract](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/standing-desks/nouli/main/docs/contracts/decisions.md): `choice`, `noul`, and `score` questions and the compact question syntax
- [Configuration](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/standing-desks/nouli/main/docs/configuration.md): providers, models, credentials, and storage
- [Workflows](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/standing-desks/nouli/main/docs/cli-workflows.md): dependent decisions and resuming interrupted runs

## Optional

- [User guide](https://standing-desks.github.io/nouli/guide/): a walkthrough of setup, sessions, branching, and blending
- [Rust library](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/standing-desks/nouli/main/docs/embedding.md): embedding Nouli in an application
- [Examples](https://standing-desks.github.io/nouli/examples/): recorded walkthroughs, including the food recall decision graph
